merchandisingData.promotionDescription: King of the Court: Enter for a share of $1M in Bonus Bets
merchandisingData.terms:
Thank you for choosing to participate in this promotion (the “Promotion”) being offered by DraftKings. By entering or participating in the Promotion you hereby agree to be bound by these Promotion terms (the “Promotion Terms,” together with the DraftKings Terms of Use and General Rules, the “Terms”). If you do not wish to be bound by the Promotion Terms, please do not enter or participate in the Promotion. If you have any questions regarding the Promotion or the Terms, or wish to cancel your participation in this Promotion, please contact support@draftkings.com for more information.

**DESCRIPTION**
Customers can opt in and get 1 Qualifying Bet Token to use on who they think will be King of the Court for a shot at a share of $1,000,000 in Bonus Bets.

**DATE AND TIME OF PROMOTION**
This Promotion will be offered periodically and is valid each day when offered between 10/12/2026 and 6/30/2027 from 12:00 AM Eastern Time (ET) and the start of the final NBA game each day when offered (the “Promotional Period”). If the 2026-2027 NBA season concludes prior to 6/30/2027, the Promotional Period will end at the conclusion of that final NBA game.

**ELIGIBILITY**
To be eligible for DraftKings Sportsbook and the Promotion, you must be physically located in AR, AZ, CO, CT, DC, IA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA (select parishes), MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, PR (residents only), TN, VA, VT, WA, WV or WY (each an “Eligible Jurisdiction” or, collectively, the “Eligible Jurisdictions”). Must be 21+ years of age or older (18+ if in DC/NH/PR/WY). Any customer who is found to be ineligible to play on DraftKings (i.e., by way of self-exclusion from gambling, restriction due to employment, or otherwise) may not participate in this Promotion and immediately forfeits any bonus rewards which have been awarded under this Promotion.

**REQUIRED ACTIONS**
In addition to the eligibility requirements set forth above and in the DraftKings Terms of Use, to participate in the Promotion, customers must (1) be a registered DraftKings Sportsbook customer with an active account; (2) receive an offer to participate in this Promotion; (3) opt-in by clicking on the appropriate link or button prior to the start of the final NBA game each day when offered; (4) receive one (1) Qualifying Bet Token to use on a Qualifying Bet (defined in Section 8) for a shot at a share of the King of the Court bonus prize pool; and (5) place a Qualifying Bet using the Token to be eligible for a reward.

**BONUS REWARD REDEMPTION AND LIMITATIONS**
Upon completion of the promotion requirements, eligible customers will be awarded one (1) Qualifying Bet Token (the "Token"). Customer must use the Token when placing their Qualifying Bet. Token valid only on pre-game NBA player prop singles bets and single player parlays (the “Qualifying Bet"). Qualifying Bet limitations can be found in Section 8 below.

**QUALIFYING BET TOKEN LIMITATIONS**: Tokens are single-use and have no cash value. Token must be applied BEFORE placing bet to receive a reward. Tokens may not be combined with other bonus rewards and may not be eligible for use on all promotions and/or betting markets. Token expires at the start of the final NBA game each day when offered.

**POINTS-REBOUNDS-ASSIST BONUS PRIZE POO**L: Qualified customers who place a bet on the day’s Points-Rebounds-Assists stat leader (the “King of the Court”) using their Token will receive an equal share of a $1,000,000 bonus prize pool. Bonus prize pool will be paid out to each winning customer as one (1) Bonus Bet or multiple equal amount Bonus Bets. For example, if 100,000 customers opted in to this Promotion and selected the day’s Points-Rebounds-Assists leader, each of those 100,000 customers would receive one (1) $10 Bonus Bet (1,000,000/100,000). Bonus Bet reward will be rounded to the nearest whole dollar. Bonus Bet will be issued within 72 business hours. Qualifying Bets will be settled in accordance with outcome of the event for which they were placed. Qualifying Bet does not need to win to be eligible for the Bonus Prize Pool.

Points-Rebounds-Assists statistics recorded will be defined by the Game’s official governing body (the National Basketball League).

In the event that two or more players tie for King of the Court, the bonus prize pool will be split among all qualified customers who placed a Qualifying Bet on those players. If zero customers have placed a Qualifying Bet on the King of the Court, the qualified customers who placed a Qualifying Bet on the next highest P-R-A leader will split the bonus prize pool , provided at least one customer placed a Qualifying Bet on that player..

**BONUS BET LIMITATIONS**: Bonus Bets are single-use, non-transferable, non-withdrawable, and have no cash value. Bonus Bets are valid for seven (7) days (168 hours) from the time they are credited to customers’ accounts. Customers can choose when to use Bonus Bets and must select the Bonus Bet in their betslip before placing a wager. Failure to use a Bonus Bet before expiration will void the reward. Payouts from Bonus Bet wagers will be transferred to the customer’s cash balance and do not include the Bonus Bet stake. Ex: If a $10 bonus bet is placed at +100 odds and wins, only the profit of $10 will be credited to the customer’s account. Bonus Bets may not be combined with other bonus rewards and may not be eligible for use on all promotions and/or betting markets.

**REGISTRATION**
See DraftKings Terms of Use for information on eligibility for creating, using, and funding an interactive gaming account.

**LIMITS ON PARTICIPATION**
Limit one (1) redemption per customer. Reward substitutions or changes will be made in DraftKings's sole discretion. See DraftKings Sportsbook Terms of Use for information and limitations on wagering.

**WAGERING RESTRICTIONS AND LIMITATIONS**
Qualifying Bet must be placed using cash from your cash balance or DK Dollars. Maximum Qualifying Bet varies. Please log in for additional details.

Token valid only on pre-game NBA player prop singles bets and single player parlays with minimum odds of -200 or longer (-150, +100, +200, etc.) (the “Qualifying Bet”). Minimum $5 Qualifying Bet.

All other bet types are excluded from this Promotion. Cashed-out bets and voided bets will void this Promotion. Bets placed with bonus rewards (including but not limited to Bonus Bets, Odds Boosts/Surges, Profit Boosts, etc.) are not valid.

**ORDER OF FUNDS USED FOR WAGERING**
Funds are wagered in the following order: (i) DK Dollars, then (ii) Cash in your cash balance.

**ELIGIBLE GAMES**
Promotion Eligible Games: Token valid only on pre-game NBA player prop singles bets and single player parlays each day when offered.

**RESTRICTIONS ON WITHDRAWAL OF FUNDS**
You may withdraw funds deposited in connection with this Promotion subject to the Terms. Any wager placed on DraftKings Sportsbook in connection with the Promotion cannot be rescinded once it has been placed. Subject to any play-through restrictions in connection with a promotion, funds earned from winnings may be withdrawn at any time.

**RULES REGARDING CANCELLATION**
Should you wish to cancel your participation in this promotion at any time, please contact customer experience at sportsbook@draftkings.com. Upon cancellation, you may withdraw any remaining funds deposited in connection with this promotion subject to the Terms. Any wager placed on DraftKings Sportsbook in connection with the promotion cannot be rescinded once it has been placed. However, any applicable bonus rewards in your account shall be void, subject to forfeiture, and may not be transferred or withdrawn.

**RESPONSIBLE GAMING**
If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, help is available, Call 1-800-GAMBLER, or 1-800-522-4700. or 1-800-MY-RESET.

**OTHER INFORMATION**
Whether a customer has committed abuse of this Promotion, or violated the Terms, will be determined by DraftKings in its sole discretion, for any reason or no reason at all. All promotions are subject to the DraftKings Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. By accepting any bonus rewards, registered customers agree to abide by the Terms. Promotional offer is subject to regulatory approval. Void where prohibited by law. DraftKings account holders are responsible for any and all local, state, or federal taxes. DraftKings is not liable for computer or program malfunctions, nor for errors in bonus rewards. DraftKings reserves the right to exclude or remove certain customers from this Promotion, as well as the right to withhold bonus rewards if you have violated or attempted to violate the Terms, including but not limited to sharing account credentials with other individuals, placing wagers on behalf of other individuals, circumventing DraftKings age and location verification procedures, and abusing the DraftKings Platform, the Services, or any bonuses, the refer-a-friend program, or any other offers or promotions, including this Promotion, in any way.

If physically located in PA, this Promotion will comply with subsection §813.3 regarding cancellation in this Promotion by a customer. If in NY, if a customer is dissatisfied with any resolution between the customer and DraftKings, the customer may then submit an inquiry with the New York State Gaming Commission.

See DraftKings Terms of Use for information on eligibility for creating, using, and funding an interactive gaming account. DraftKings reserves the right to suspend, modify, and/or cancel this Promotion for any reason in its sole discretion.

13. Eligibility: Must be 21+ and physically located in AR, AZ, CO, CT, IA, IL, IN, KS, LA (select parishes), MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, TN, VA, VT, WA, or WV. 18+ and physically located in DC/KY/NH/PR (residents only)/WY.

Excludes Parlays, SGPx, odds boosts, live, cashed out and voided bets

Limit One (1) redemption per customer. Reward substitutions or changes will be made in DraftKings's sole discretion. See DraftKings Sportsbook Terms of Use for information and limitations on wagering.

(8) WAGERING RESTRICTIONS AND LIMITATIONS

Qualifying Bet must be placed using cash from your cash balance or DK Dollars. Qualifying Bet must have minimum odds of -200 or longer (-167, +100, +150, etc.). Maximum bet limits will be clearly and conspicuously disclosed to the customer upon opting in. Only eligible legs of the Qualifying Bet will receive a profit boost; any ineligible legs (including legs from non-eligible leagues, games, or sports) will not receive a boost.

All other bet types are excluded from this Promotion. Cashed-out bets and voided bets will void this Promotion. Bets placed with bonus rewards (including but not limited to Bonus Bets, Odds Boosts/Surges, Profit Boosts, etc.) are not valid.

(9) ORDER OF FUNDS USED FOR WAGERING

Funds are wagered in the following order: (i) DK Dollars, then (ii) Cash in your cash balance.

(10) ELIGIBLE GAMES

Promotion Eligible Games: Token valid only for a NBA Single, Parlay, SGP, or SGPx bet.

(11) RESTRICTIONS ON WITHDRAWAL OF FUNDS

You may withdraw funds deposited in connection with this Promotion subject to the Terms. Any wager placed on DraftKings Sportsbook in connection with the Promotion cannot be rescinded once it has been placed. Subject to any play-through restrictions in connection with a promotion, funds earned from winnings may be withdrawn at any time.

(12) RULES REGARDING CANCELLATION

Should you wish to cancel your participation in this promotion at any time, please contact customer experience at sportsbook@draftkings.com. Upon cancellation, you may withdraw any remaining funds deposited in connection with this promotion subject to the Terms. Any wager placed on DraftKings Sportsbook in connection with the promotion cannot be rescinded once it has been placed. However, any applicable bonus rewards in your account shall be void, subject to forfeiture, and may not be transferred or withdrawn.

(13) RESPONSIBLE GAMING

If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, help is available, Call 1-800-GAMBLER, or 1-800-MY-RESET. In Ontario: Concerned about your Gambling? Call ConnexOntario 1-866-531-2600. In Alberta: If gambling is affecting your mental health or well-being, 211 Alberta is here to help. Call or text 211 or visit ab.211.ca.

(14) OTHER INFORMATION

Whether a customer has committed abuse of this Promotion, or violated the Terms, will be determined by DraftKings in its sole discretion, for any reason or no reason at all. DraftKings reserves the right to exclude or remove certain customers from this Promotion, as well as the right to withhold bonus rewards if you have violated or attempted to violate the Terms, including but not limited to sharing account credentials with other individuals, placing wagers on behalf of other individuals, circumventing DraftKings age and location verification procedures, and abusing the DraftKings Platform, the Services, or any bonuses, the refer-a-friend program, or any other offers or promotions, including this Promotion, in any way.

If physically located in PA, this Promotion will comply with subsection §813.3 regarding cancellation in this Promotion by a customer.

If in NY, if a customer is dissatisfied with any resolution between the customer and DraftKings, the customer may then submit an inquiry with the New York State Gaming Commission.
